279tommy_inline tommy_hashtable_node* tommy_hashtable_find(tommy_hashtable* hashtable, tommy_search_func* cmp, const void* cmp_arg, tommy_hash_t hash)
280{
281 tommy_hashtable_node* i = tommy_hashtable_bucket(hashtable, hash);
282
283 while (i) {
284 /* we first check if the hash matches, as in the same bucket we may have multiple hash values */
285 if (i->index == hash && cmp(cmp_arg, i->data) == 0)
286 return i;
287 i = i->next;
288 }
289 return 0;
290}
291
303tommy_inline void* tommy_hashtable_search(tommy_hashtable* hashtable, tommy_search_func* cmp, const void* cmp_arg, tommy_hash_t hash)
304{
305 tommy_hashtable_node* node = tommy_hashtable_find(hashtable, cmp, cmp_arg, hash);
306
307 return node ? node->data : 0;
308}
